Bounded CT production controller (no production launch made)

scripts/run_ct_simulations.py defaults to preparation only. Explicitly provide
--executable and --code-receipt; --run is required to launch. Example preparation:
 python scripts/run_ct_simulations.py ct96_w30 ct96_w60 --prepare-only \
   --executable solver/athena_ct_fast/x3i_ct_fast \
   --code-receipt solver/athena_ct_fast/frozen_fast.json

All19 requested geometry/physics scenarios are defined, with final physical
controls based on ct96_w30. Width30/45/60 preserve the same3.75deg theta spacing
and fullsphere target grid. Outer132-cell buffer preserves the96-case radial
spacing exactly (rmax~3.125006AU). Full cases cover day9..34, with the separate
start6 control. Uniform radius,CFL.25,SSPRK2,one CPU/native volume-weighted centers
are explicit in matching run.cfg and athinput.ct. Halfdt uses CFL.125.

The supplied frozen fast receipt enables only passive bookkeeping flags1; no
physical update changes. Exact executable, own-source and parent hashes are
verified. A binary/source/receipt copy under solver/athena_ct_pins/<receiptSHA>/
provides portable execution. ROOT-relative input_code_provenance.json includes
archived own/source files, binary, input files and immutable canonical metadata.
External/tmp build pins are separately recorded and exact listed files archived;
first preparation currently requires their original files for verification.
Subsequent execution uses the ROOT binary, with no runtime/tmp dependency.

Prospective frozen-Br uses the existing frozen-Br CSV path and needs an explicit
input-parity capability attestation; cones need an integrated code capability.
Unsupported plans can be reviewed but cannot execute. Optional input-only
capability receipt plumbing can be added after the current qualification.

No completed case is regenerated without --force. A completed case whose code
receipt, canonical config, native input or recorded provenance differs is rejected.
--force archives earlier artifacts under previous_attempts before another attempt.
Execution completion is separate from scientific gates. Fresh statistics and
accepted ct_trace endpoints/order/stage counts are required, since native Athena
can return0 after an exception. Physics gates include actual ghost fast Mach>1,
positive density/pressure,floor0,strict pre-floor abort policy,and stage/end target
Br tracking. Work residuals/thermal fidelity/convergence need independent review.
A scientific-gate failure preserves valid completed artifacts; incomplete markers
are retained as incomplete_statistics.json so legacy readers cannot mistake them
for completed production volumes.

Limits: default2 simultaneous one-thread CPU jobs, maximum4; nice15; separate
ct_runner.lock; aggregate process-tree RSS3GiB; sampled per-job RSS1GiB default;
finite AS2GiB default; CPU2400s/wall3600s default, each hard upper7200s. Initial
case predicate<=1.2million cells. Atomic monitoring/ct_progress.json and per-case
candidate_status.json/runner_usage.json record progress/results. /usr/bin/time -v
resource_usage.txt is the authoritative per-process CPU/RSS source; no cumulative
RUSAGE_CHILDREN interpretation. Full campaign launch remains a separate root
choice after cost and physics review. This controller does not enable OpenMP or
multiple MeshBlocks; that requires separately qualified code and controller API.

Qualification: external_model/athena_ct_validation/controller_verification.json
and controller_plans/. Tests prepared all19 cases and verified exact config/native
agreement, ROOT-relative hashes, fixed consumer sphere for width controls,
capability blocking, valid completion, subfast scientific failure with retained
artifacts, missing-marker/endpoint rejection, immutable repeated pins, mismatch
rejection and completed code/config reuse rejection. No forward simulation was
started by these controller tests. Native field audit is separately available
as solver/audit_ct_fields.py and can be run by root after completed campaigns.
EOF
